project.purpose: Source-grounded first recursive R2.1 responsibilities for the existing read-only Skills bridge, without making its catalog a universal LEGO Registry or assuming runtime installation.

nodes.label: ReadOnlySkillBridge
nodes.responsibility: Expose scoped Skill metadata, exact binding, and revision-fenced advisory resource reads over the existing MCP/SEP-2640 protocols; never run or authorize a Skill.
nodes.authority: Skills bridge; MCP SDK owns transport protocol
inputs: configured SkillSource set and caller context
outputs: read-only metadata, exact Skill binding, or bounded advisory resource projection
nodes.behavioralContract: Only owner-admitted and context-visible Skills are exposed; requests cannot install, mutate, authorize, or execute a Skill; this composition does not guarantee a Gateway Skills route.
acceptance: Native MCP Skills methods delegate discovery, resolution, and read to the scoped catalog; absent deployment/configuration remains UNKNOWN.
No Skill contents or declaration confers Runtime Tool execution authority.
formalObligations: A chosen MCP request cannot mutate the catalog or grant Runtime execution authority.
Qualify active installed service and consumer source match separately from repository contract.

nodes.label: SourceQualifiedSkillInventory
nodes.responsibility: Represent filesystem SkillSource inventories as provenance-bound SkillRecord and source health facts without pretending the inventory is installed Skill truth.
nodes.authority: Skills source catalog and declared source policy
nodes.behavioralContract: Inventory admission requires parsed Skill metadata and package-safety observation; source-relative identities and revisions derive from scanned bytes; untrusted/quarantined packages must not silently enter an admitted view.
acceptance: The source catalog records exact source/scope and package identity.
Quarantined and malformed Skills do not enter the qualified view.
formalObligations: A source/package collision must not silently impersonate a different Skill identity.
A static file scan is not execution, deployment or safe behavior proof.

nodes.label: ContextScopedSkillDiscovery
nodes.responsibility: Expose a context-scoped, precedence-qualified Skill listing and lexical-search projection without installing, selecting, or executing a Skill.
inputs: lexical search and optional source/scope filters
outputs: visible Skill metadata and context snapshotRevision
nodes.behavioralContract: Implicit list/search omit blocked, quarantined, untrusted or context-inapplicable Skills; duplicate names obey deterministic source/scope precedence; discovery does not confer effect authority.
acceptance: A Skill hidden by context or quarantine does not appear in implicit discovery.
Search results remain suggestions, not provider admission.
formalObligations: Context and invocation mode cannot be silently dropped from discovery.
Catalog snapshot identity must cover the effective context-visible record set.

nodes.label: ExactSkillResolution
nodes.responsibility: Resolve an explicit Skill identity or a friendly name to one stable effective Skill binding with deterministic precedence and fail-closed snapshot fencing.
outputs: SkillResolution with selected SkillRecord and snapshotRevision
nodes.behavioralContract: Stale snapshot, blocked/quarantined/invisible/unfound records cannot be returned as a successful matching binding; duplicate names use deterministic source precedence.
acceptance: A stale expected snapshot is rejected.
A canonical Skill ID binds to its exact visible source, not an unrelated same-name Skill.
formalObligations: A successful returned binding satisfies scope/trust and expected snapshot assumptions.
Resolved identity is distinct from execution permission.

nodes.label: RevisionFencedAdvisoryRead
nodes.responsibility: Read a specified Skill resource under exact package/instruction/snapshot checks and deliver an advisory projection with bounded UTF-8 reads; no script execution.
outputs: SkillReadResult, hashes, projection and next offset
nodes.behavioralContract: Reject path escape, unsupported media, changed package or instruction identity and stale snapshot; do not elevate Skill text to control-plane authority; file reads remain read-only.
acceptance: A changed SKILL.md/package is rejected even if a previously resolved SkillRef exists.
Unsafe control-plane/self-routing instructions do not receive implicit authority from a successful read.
formalObligations: Snapshot/bytes fences must reject stale package and hostile resource paths.
Model-facing projection is not a proof of harmless meaning or authority.

nodes.label: SkillPackageRiskAndEligibility
nodes.responsibility: Assess package hazards and declared environment eligibility before Skill implicit discovery while keeping advisory text separate from execution authority.
nodes.authority: Skills package scanner and eligibility adapter
inputs: declared requirements and context eligibility policy
nodes.behavioralContract: Credential-bearing packages fail closed from admitted discovery; risky instructions cannot self-authorize implicit invocation; explicit user selection and audit have separate scoped rules.
acceptance: Credential material is quarantined at the native scanner boundary.
Implicit discovery remains distinct from explicit Skill selection.
mustNotOwn: formal proof that all malicious instructions are detected
formalObligations: Quarantine cannot be weakened through a metadata or routing bypass.
Scanner rejection coverage is bounded, not a universal prompt-injection proof.

nodes.label: StandardsBoundResourceManifest
nodes.responsibility: Project an eligible Skill into SEP-2640-compatible resource metadata and exact advertised-bytes retrieval while deferring MCP transport to its official SDK.
nodes.authority: Skills SEP-2640 adapter; Agent Skills/MCP standards external
outputs: SEP-2640 Skill manifest with resource sizes/digests
nodes.behavioralContract: Advertised resources must be regular, package-contained and bounded; reads reject unadvertised, relocated or changed resource bytes; scoped project/workspace Skills cannot be read without matching context.
acceptance: A symlink or resource absent from the manifest fails the native standard resource boundary.
A changed resource cannot be delivered as an unchanged advertised digest.
formalObligations: No manifest-qualified read may resolve outside its admitted Skill package.
Real external consumer availability and installed currentness remain UNKNOWN.

slices.label: SourceAndContextQualifiedDiscovery
acceptance: Repo native source and direct MCP consumers are identified; this is not proof of installed matching bytes.

slices.label: ExactResolutionAndAdvisoryRead
acceptance: Exact resolution, bounded resource read and SEP-2640 delivery are independently named and source-bound; external Gateway route qualification remains UNKNOWN.

nonClaims: Nodes describe responsibility boundaries and source-qualified consumer entrypoints, not mathematical implementation proofs.
Actual tool-client routing, installed service executable, distributed caller identity and dynamic consumers remain separate owner facts.
SK00 is an existing MCP surface composition, not a new Registry, plugin system or runtime authority.
